text:
Ɛfiri 1 kɔsi 25 June 1978 no, Argentina na ɛyɛ FIFA World Cup a ɛto so 11 no guro, agorɔ a wɔyɛɛ wɔ ɔman no akannifoɔ nsa mu na wɔnni nsisɛm a ɛfa amammui nsesaeɛ ne agorɔ a wɔatɔ ho. Akuo 16 na wɔde dii agorɔ a ɛbɛyɛ World Cup a ɛto so akyi a wɔde kɔɔ mu wɔ 1982 mu. Wɔkyekyɛɛ akuo no mu kɔɔ akuo anan a ɛwɔ mu anan wɔ round a ɛdi kan; wɔn a wɔdi kan mmienu wɔ mu biara kɔɔ round a ɛto so mmienu a ɛwɔ mu anan, na wɔn a wɔdi kan wɔ round a ɛto so no mu hyia wɔ final na wɔn a wɔdi akyi no bɔ agorɔ a ɛfa ɔkwan a ɛto so mmiɛnsa ho.

Ɔman no kwan kɔɔ final no mu danee wɔ 6-0 a wɔdi Peru so wɔ second-round group a ɛdi akyi no mu, na saa result no na ɛmaa Argentina kɔɔ final na wɔnni nsisɛm a ɛfa sɛ wɔatɔ ho. Wɔn a wɔretwɛn wɔn wɔ Buenos Aires Estadio Monumental no ne Netherlands, a wɔsan kɔɔ final no mu mprenu a ɛto so wɔ 1974 mu. Wɔn a wɔyɛ 71,483 no mu, Mario Kempes buee agorɔ no wɔ 38th minute, nanso Dick Nanninga san dii mu wɔ 82nd. Ɛberɛ a agorɔ no kɔɔ mu no, Kempes san dii Argentina anim wɔ 105th minute na Daniel Bertoni too ɔkwan a ɛto so mmiɛnsa wɔ 115th, na ɔde 3-1 dii wɔ extra time mu.

Argentina dii akansie no mprɛ a ɛdi kan, na ɔbɛyɛ ɔman a ɛto so enum a wɔdi World Cup sɛ gurofoɔ. Netherlands a wɔsan dii akyi no, wɔmpɛɛ sɛ wɔkɔ post-match ceremonies no mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni nkitahodie a ɛka Rene van de Kerkhof nsa cast ho ne Argentina nsesaeɛ. Brazil dii ɔkwan a ɛto so mmiɛnsa. Kempes na ɔyɛ agorɔ no mu ɔbarima a ɔda nsow, na ɔdi akanfoɔ anim wɔ goals 6 na ɔno na ɔde goals mmienu wɔ final no mu maa ɔman no dii akansie no.

Beaeɛ foforɔ so, agorɔ no maa Tunisia 3-1 a wɔdi Mexico so yɛ World Cup finals a ɛdi kan a African team dii mu. Wɔ agorɔ no nyinaa mu no, nnipa a wɔbaa hɔ no yɛ 1,545,791, na ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 40,679 wɔ match biara mu.
